runs.name: g0-pics-default
runs.description: step G0 pictures: default, at 300 s: neon, the stirred streamlines, a torn junction close up, harmonic

evals.js: const { readBuffer } = await import('./src/snapshot.js'); const C = moire.cells, n = C.count, F = 92; const ab = await readBuffer(C.device, C.cellBuf, 0, n * F * 4); const f = new Float32Array(ab), u = new Uint32Array(ab); let best = null, bn = -1; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const o = i * F; if (!(u[o + 9] & 1) || !(u[o + 8] & 63)) continue; let k = 0; for (let j = 0; j < n; j += 2) { const q = j * F; if ((u[q + 9] & 1) && Math.hypot(f[q] - f[o], f[q + 1] - f[o + 1]) < 3 * C.R) k++; } if (k > bn) { bn = k; best = [f[o], f[o + 1]]; } } if (best) moire.camera.set(8, best[0], best[1]); return JSON.stringify({best, bn})
